Are you in need of New York international credential evaluation services? If so, American Education and Translation Services will meet and exceed your expectations. We provide foreign credential evaluation services to individuals, agencies, institutions and healthcare companies. We look forward to serving your needs and providing you with high quality services that allow you to seek a higher education, get work authorization or approve immigration status.

What are International Credential Evaluation Services in New York NY?

Foreign credential evaluation services are mainly used for people who have studied outside the United States. Usually, these services are requested for individuals who want to further their education, obtain professional licensure, enlist in the military or seek employment. They may also be requested for immigration purposes.

By choosing reputable New York international credential evaluation services, you can expect accurate evaluation that are accepted by your respective agency or organization. American Education and Translation Services processes thousands of evaluations every year, and all of them are 100% accepted by government agencies such as USCIS and employers.

Why Choose Us for Foreign Credential Evaluation Services

Besides credential evaluation, American Education and Translation Services also offers a broad range of translation services under one roof. Our employees are highly trained and experienced, and collectively, we translate over 100 languages. No matter where you have studied in the past, we can provide you with accurate international credential evaluation services and certified translation services at one stop in New York NY.

Reasons for choosing us include:

  • Fast service. Most evaluation services are completed within a few business days, though some take longer, such as position evaluations and course-by-course evaluations.
  • Affordable pricing. Our rates are upfront and honest, so you’ll never have to guess what you’ll pay to use our services. Ask about new customer discounts and referral rewards.
  • Convenient one stop evaluation and translation service.
  • Helpful customer service. With real offices in the metropolitan areas, you can count on us for hands-on service, fast response times and professionally trained translators.

To request a free estimate, or to send your documents to us for New York international credential evaluation services, please contact American Education and Translation Services today.
